rubric.role_summary: On-site field solutions technician for industrial robot automation, programming and testing solutions in Munich and commissioning, integrating, and supporting them at customer sites across Germany.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
On-site field solutions technician for industrial robot automation, programming and testing solutions in Munich and commissioning, integrating, and supporting them at customer sites across Germany.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Training in automation technology, such as mechatronics technician, electronics technician, or mechatronics engineer training, or a comparable qualification.
- Initial experience commissioning automation solutions or similar technologies.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Munich, Germany area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
